text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Ardan, I'm sorry... for your birthday 
present... They didn't have any luxury 
cruise ships for sale.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Wait, you left out way too many details! 
It's a "ticket to a luxury cruise ship 
party"!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
—Look, you said it before, right? That you 
"wanted to try throwing a party with 
everyone". So, I went and looked for one.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Yeah~ But you don't see this kind of thing 
every day. It's on a whole other level 
compared to our takoyaki parties, ya know?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Soft, melty batter... plump, juicy 
octopus... Savory, fragrant sauce, and 
dancing bonito flakes...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
—Let us go shopping. For the takoyaki 
party, that is.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Sounds good. I'll help out too. Let's make 
it a delicious birthday, Ardan.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Yes. It's a wonderful, magnificent party. 
Making it all together, gathering around, 
and blowing on it to cool it down.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
And then... we mustn't forget the aonori. 
Just so I can say, "You've got seaweed on 
your face." Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
—Wait, what's all this?! So you two bonded 
over a takoyaki party after all! In that 
case, I'll grill up as many as ya want~!
